description: Create an API key for an app you are building, to store as a secret in its environment (for example TEXTKIT_API_KEY) so the app can send texts itself. Same mode (test or live) as this connection; optional scopes limit it. The secret is returned once; the account owner is emailed.

name.description: What the key is for, e.g. "Booking app"

scopes.description: Limit the key to these scopes (see /docs/authentication). Omit for full access (full-access callers only).

name: create_api_key
title: Create api key
